comparison_question: Given only the documented BEFORE customer-call process, did the AI Adoption Engine identify opportunity areas that substantially align with the later documented Elisa intervention, while behaving responsibly where evidence was insufficient?

after_sources.provenance: organisation-authored success accounts and corporate reporting

themes.after_intervention_theme: Natural-language capture and classification of the caller's reason for contact

after_evidence.claim: The service bot asks callers to describe their reason in natural language and interprets that reason.

before_activities.activity: Customer selects menu options using the telephone keypad

themes.human_review_provenance: Live extraction left the categorisation signal unknown. Phase 4 corrected it from the explicit BEFORE statement that the customer selects a topic option; no natural-language or speech capability was added.
themes.explanation: The validated product identified the underlying topic-classification opportunity, which is part of the later intervention. It did not identify natural-language understanding or speech processing and did not recommend adoption.
themes.remaining_limitation: CLASSIFICATION is broader than natural-language intent recognition, and the frozen taxonomy contains no dedicated speech-recognition capability.

themes.after_intervention_theme: Automated routing to a suitably specialised agent

after_evidence.claim: After interpreting the caller's reason, the bot routes the call to a suitable specialist agent.

before_activities.activity: Customer selects menu options using the telephone keypad
System routes the call to a specialised service agent

themes.human_review_provenance: Phase 4 source-boundedly corrected the explicit routing step's routes-or-orchestrates-work signal. The correction used only the BEFORE sentence stating that the system routes according to the selected option.
themes.explanation: The validated product combined classification and workflow-automation capabilities around the same routing boundary later changed by Elisa. The deterministic engine still returned INVESTIGATE_FURTHER and did not specify an intent-aware conversational router.
themes.remaining_limitation: The BEFORE packet did not establish routing accuracy, intent-model performance, training data, exception handling or acceptable misrouting risk.

themes.after_intervention_theme: Reduction of wrong routing and call retransfers

after_evidence.claim: Elisa reports higher routing accuracy than the previous keypad menu and three times fewer retransfers.

before_activities.activity: Receiving agent retransfers a misrouted call

themes.human_review_provenance: The reviewer corrected the routing/orchestration signal because the BEFORE step explicitly describes retransfer to a better-qualified agent. The review did not add the later performance result.
themes.explanation: The product recognised the retransfer activity as a workflow-routing opportunity at the same operational pain point later reported as improved. It neither predicted the magnitude of improvement nor recommended deployment.
themes.remaining_limitation: The reported accuracy and retransfer figures are organisation-authored outcomes without an independent method, sample size or error distribution.

themes.after_intervention_theme: Self-service chatbot answers for contacts not requiring a human agent

after_evidence.locator: Documented intervention and reported outcomes sections
after_evidence.claim: Annika also handled some customer questions through self-service rather than routing every contact to a human.

before_activities.activity: Appropriately specialised agent addresses the customer's question

themes.human_review_provenance: The BEFORE packet explicitly withheld the information and systems agents use to answer questions. Knowledge retrieval, content generation and decision-support signals therefore remained unknown.
themes.explanation: The product reconstructed human question handling but identified no capability corresponding to self-service answering. Generic uncertainty is not credited as identifying the later chatbot intervention.
themes.remaining_limitation: The frozen BEFORE process intentionally excluded a synthetic live-chat workflow, answer-retrieval procedure or knowledge-base description.

themes.after_intervention_theme: Retained human-agent handling for contacts that still require a person

after_evidence.claim: The later service retained specialist agents for routed calls and contacts not suitable for self-service.

before_activities.activity: Appropriately specialised agent addresses the customer's question

themes.human_review_provenance: The human-agent activity was accepted, but human-accountability, escalation, verification and consequences of incorrect advice remained unknown.
themes.explanation: The product preserved the human activity and avoided an unsupported automation recommendation, but it did not identify or design the later human-retention boundary. That caution is recorded separately as appropriate uncertainty.
themes.remaining_limitation: The BEFORE packet did not distinguish simple from complex questions or state which contacts must remain with a human.

reported_outcomes.reported_value: approximately 90% routing accuracy versus 70-75% for the previous keypad menu; three times fewer retransfers
reported_outcomes.scope_note: Organisation-authored call-routing account; methodology and denominator are not independently reported.

reported_outcomes.reported_value: up to 70% of inbound contacts handled; 42% of handled contacts fully resolved, described as 34% of all inbound contacts
reported_outcomes.scope_note: Implementation-partner reporting; channel, year and denominator differ from Elisa's sustainability measure.

reported_outcomes.measure: share of all incoming Estonia contacts resolved
reported_outcomes.scope_note: Elisa 2022 corporate-report measure; it is not averaged or treated as directly comparable with MindTitan's figures.

appropriate_uncertainty.gate_trace: Evidence sufficiency passed, then technical fit failed because ai_capability_fit was unknown. Business-value and risk/autonomy gates were not evaluated after that stopping result.
appropriate_uncertainty.explanation: The BEFORE document established classification and routing activities but did not supply an evidence-backed ordinal AI capability-fit judgement. INVESTIGATE_FURTHER therefore followed the frozen policy and is not treated as contradiction merely because Elisa later deployed AI.

material_missing_information: consequences of incorrect routing or advice
appropriate_uncertainty.gate_trace: These values remained unknown but were not the recorded stopping reason because technical fit had already failed on ai_capability_fit.
appropriate_uncertainty.explanation: The gaps prevent a responsible decision about conversational self-service, autonomous routing or human-service boundaries from BEFORE evidence alone.

process_reconstruction.ordering: All six explicit source activities were retained in numbered order. One erroneous forward dependency on the keypad-selection step was rejected and its blocking conflict resolved.
process_reconstruction.evidence_resolution: All accepted evidence references resolve exactly to the frozen Phase 2 document.
process_reconstruction.limitations: The public BEFORE packet is a concise retrospective description, not an operational call-centre SOP, and omits answering systems, controls and quantitative conditions.

recognized_later_themes: CLASSIFICATION at the customer topic-selection boundary
missed_later_themes: self-service answer generation or approved-knowledge retrieval
capability_recognition.review_dependency: The live extraction left all three recognised positive signals unknown; Phase 4 supplied the final mappings from explicit BEFORE wording.

deterministic_recommendation.explanation: The engine did not recommend deployment. Every source-backed activity passed evidence sufficiency and then stopped at technical fit because ai_capability_fit was unknown. This is neither strong intervention alignment nor contradiction.

demonstrated_effects: Corrected the topic-selection categorisation signal from unknown to true using BEFORE evidence.
Corrected two explicit routing/retransfer signals from unknown to true using BEFORE evidence.
Rejected an incorrect forward dependency and resolved the resulting structural conflict.
Retained 123 unsupported assertions as unknown rather than completing them from research knowledge.
Accepted the source's six-step order without adding or deleting an activity.
No AFTER content entered the production extraction request or validated-process record.
human_review_contribution.limitation: The reviewing research agent had prior exposure to public AFTER evidence. Although every correction is independently supported by literal BEFORE wording, fully blind reviewer independence cannot be claimed.

case_conclusion: The live product reconstructed the six-step customer-call process, and the full extraction-plus-review workflow identified classification and routing opportunities at the same process boundaries later changed by Elisa. It did not identify natural-language understanding, self-service answering or the explicit retained-human boundary. All six deterministic outcomes remained INVESTIGATE_FURTHER because the BEFORE evidence did not establish AI capability fit or the controls and performance evidence required for adoption. PORT-002 therefore shows partial opportunity alignment and responsible uncertainty, not a prediction or recommendation of Elisa's deployment.
recruiter_friendly_conclusion: The unchanged product was tested on a frozen public call-centre case using live extraction and a deterministic policy. It reconstructed six process steps; human review corrected one dependency and three missed capability signals; the final assessment identified classification and routing opportunities later used in practice, while refusing to recommend deployment without evidence. It also transparently missed the later self-service chatbot function.
limitations: Elisa's sources are organisation-authored success accounts, while MindTitan was the implementation partner.
The AFTER evidence is retrospective reference evidence, not independently established ground truth.
The 90%, 70-75%, three-times-fewer, 70%, 42%, 34% and 8% figures have different scopes, years or denominators and are not combined.
No independent routing-quality, customer-harm, resolution-quality or negative-outcome evaluation was found.
The live extraction itself missed all three positive capability signals; final capability recognition depended materially on human review.
The reviewing research agent had prior public AFTER exposure, so blind reviewer independence cannot be claimed despite source-bounded corrections.
The anonymised input reduces but does not eliminate model-memorisation contamination risk.
One case cannot support cross-case or statistical conclusions.
